# Policy Target

This folder captures the specific performance thresholds and goals established for healthcare quality indicators within the corpus. The available evidence is currently limited to a single documented target, detailing the minimum performance expectations for specific clinical metrics as outlined in national registry reports.

## Pages

- [[policy-target|Policy Target]] — Details the established performance threshold for Indikator 8, which is set at a minimum of 50% according to the 2025 AFDK report.
